dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a measure μ and real-valued function f, LocalDef001 μ f is defined as MeasureTheory.integral μ f.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Both sides of the conclusion use this definition, so the conclusion compares φ applied to the integral of X with the integral of φ composed with X.

dependency_coverage.name: Algebra.id
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs the algebra of a commutative semiring over itself, with identity algebra map and the self-scalar action arising from multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the ordinary real-on-real scalar action used by the convexity predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: Algebra.toSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the scalar-multiplication structure from an Algebra instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It passes the real scalar action to ConvexOn for both its domain and codomain.

dependency_coverage.name: CommSemiring.toSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets commutativity from a commutative semiring and returns its underlying semiring structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the semiring structure on the real scalars required by ConvexOn.

dependency_coverage.name: ConvexOn
dependency_coverage.meaning: ConvexOn 𝕜 s f is the conjunction that s is convex and that, for every x,y in s and nonnegative scalars a,b with a+b=1, f(a•x+b•y) ≤ a•f(x)+b•f(y).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With 𝕜=Real and s=Set.univ, the first hypothesis requires φ to obey the convex-combination inequality for every pair of real inputs and every nonnegative pair of real weights summing to one.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the binary less-than-or-equal relation from an LE structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the final proposition the ordinary real inequality φ(∫X dμ) ≤ ∫φ(X) dμ.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The packet gives MeasurableSpace as a type-valued declaration assigning a structure type to each carrier type, but does not provide its constructors or axioms.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: An instance on Ω is required to type the measure, integrability hypotheses, and integrals; its deeper measurable-set semantics are not supplied.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Integrable
dependency_coverage.meaning: Integrable f μ is defined as the conjunction AEStronglyMeasurable f μ and HasFiniteIntegral f μ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The proposition assumes this conjunction separately for X and for ω ↦ φ(X ω), ensuring both displayed integrals are taken under explicit integrability premises.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
dependency_coverage.meaning: The packet gives a proposition-valued declaration on a measure but omits its constructors or defining field, so only the predicate name and type are available.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem applies only when an instance of IsProbabilityMeasure μ is present; the packet does not itself establish the exact normalization property encoded by that instance.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure
dependency_coverage.meaning: The packet gives Measure as a type constructor depending on a carrier and measurable-space instance, but omits its constructors and measure axioms.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of μ and thereby the object supplied to Integrable and integral, although its full measure semantics are not derivable from the packet.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring while retaining its remaining structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is typeclass plumbing used to obtain the additive norm structure needed for real-valued integrability.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts a seminormed additive commutative group from a nonunital seminormed ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes the normed additive structure from which the continuous extended norm on Real is obtained for Integrable.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets norm definiteness from a normed commutative ring to obtain a seminormed commutative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It lies in the instance chain supplying Real with the continuous norm structure required by Integrable.

dependency_coverage.name: PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the uniform-space structure carried by a pseudometric space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Real it contributes, through the induced topology, the topological-space argument used in the two Integrable predicates.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The packet identifies Real as a type but supplies no inductive constructors or underlying construction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the scalar type, the domain and codomain of φ, and the codomain of X and both integrals; its intended real-number interpretation is supported by the listed algebraic, order, metric, and norm instances, though its construction is omitted.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the additive commutative monoid instance on Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the additive structures required in ConvexOn for both the domain and codomain of φ.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instCommSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the commutative semiring instance on Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the identity real algebra and hence the real scalar multiplications used by ConvexOn.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the less-than-or-equal relation on Real via the underlying real order relation Real.le✝.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the order relation in the conclusion and, through the partial order, in the convexity inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides Real with a commutative ring, norm, metric, and submultiplicative-norm structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It feeds the normed-structure chain required to define real-valued integrability and integration.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.partialOrder
dependency_coverage.meaning: Packages the real less-than and less-than-or-equal relations with reflexivity, transitivity, antisymmetry, and compatibility properties as a partial order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the order on coefficients and function values used in ConvexOn.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.pseudoMetricSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the real pseudometric with distance defined by |x-y|, together with its uniformity and metric laws.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its induced uniform and topological structures are used by Integrable for real-valued functions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.semiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the semiring structure on Real by typeclass inference.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the scalar semiring argument supplied directly to ConvexOn.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets commutativity from a seminormed additive commutative group while retaining its normed additive-group structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is part of the instance chain producing the ContinuousENorm structure used by Integrable.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedAddGroup.toContinuousENorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a ContinuousENorm instance from a seminormed additive group, using the extended nonnegative norm and its continuity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the ContinuousENorm argument for the real-valued Integrable predicates.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets the multiplicative identity from a seminormed commutative ring while retaining its additive, multiplicative, commutative, metric, and norm structures.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It lies in the typeclass chain used to derive the continuous norm structure for real-valued integrability.

dependency_coverage.name: Set.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The universal set is defined as the set containing every element, since its membership predicate is constantly True.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: ConvexOn is imposed on all real inputs, rather than on a proper subset or merely the range of X.

dependency_coverage.name: UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the topology carried by a uniform space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Real it supplies the topological-space argument appearing in both Integrable hypotheses.

dependency_coverage.name: InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts a normed-space structure from an inner-product-space instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It helps supply the real normed-space structure required for the Bochner integral of real-valued functions.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.integral
dependency_coverage.meaning: The declaration has the type of a Bochner integral mapping a measure and a function into the function's normed-space codomain, but its body is only exposed as the opaque projection MeasureTheory.wrapped✝.1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the operation used by LocalDef001 on X and on φ composed with X; no defining equations or off-domain conventions can be verified from this packet.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets norm definiteness from a normed additive commutative group to obtain a seminormed additive commutative group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes to the normed-instance chain for the real Bochner integral and real-valued integrability.

dependency_coverage.name: RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a real inner-product-space structure on an RCLike type, with the corresponding normed-space structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to Real, it helps provide the real normed-space argument required by MeasureTheory.integral.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instRCLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: Packages Real as an RCLike type, including its field-like, normed, complete, conjugation, real-part, imaginary-part, order, and decidable-equality data.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enables the real inner-product and normed-space instances used when integrating real-valued functions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the normed additive commutative group structure on Real, with its real norm, addition, and metric.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the normed additive codomain structure required by the Bochner integral and contributes to the structures required by Integrable.

binders: An arbitrary type Ω in an arbitrary universe.
A measure μ on Ω and an instance of the predicate MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ.
An arbitrary function X : Ω → Real.
An arbitrary function φ : Real → Real.
hypotheses: φ is ConvexOn Real Set.univ: the universal real set is convex and, for every real x,y and nonnegative real a,b with a+b=1, φ(ax+by) ≤ aφ(x)+bφ(y).
X is integrable with respect to μ, meaning that X is μ-a.e. strongly measurable and has finite integral.
The composite function ω ↦ φ(X ω) is integrable with respect to μ, meaning that it is μ-a.e. strongly measurable and has finite integral.
conclusions: φ(MeasureTheory.integral μ X) ≤ MeasureTheory.integral μ (ω ↦ φ(X ω)).
mathematical_definitions: For any real-valued f on Ω, LocalDef001 μ f is MeasureTheory.integral μ f.
Integrable f μ abbreviates AEStronglyMeasurable f μ ∧ HasFiniteIntegral f μ.
ConvexOn Real Set.univ φ includes both convexity of the universal set and the full two-point convex-combination inequality for φ on all real inputs.
The scalar operations and order appearing in convexity and in the conclusion are the listed standard structures on Real.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every measurably structured type Ω, measure μ carrying an instance of the predicate named IsProbabilityMeasure, real-valued function X, and real function φ, if φ is convex on the whole real line, X is μ-integrable, and φ∘X is μ-integrable, then φ applied to the μ-integral of X is at most the μ-integral of φ∘X.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The result is only real-valued: X takes values in Real and φ maps Real to Real.
Convexity is required on all of Real, not merely on the essential range or pointwise range of X.
Both X and φ∘X must be integrable; if any hypothesis fails, the implication gives no conclusion.
No separate global measurability or continuity assumption on φ is stated; only global convexity and integrability of φ∘X occur in the proposition.
Applicability depends on the existence of an IsProbabilityMeasure μ instance, whose defining normalization condition is not included in the packet.
The target does not encode equality conditions, strictness criteria, conditional expectations, vector-valued variables, extended-real values, or nonintegrable cases.
Although Ω is not explicitly required to be nonempty, the exact consequences of the IsProbabilityMeasure instance for Ω cannot be determined from the supplied declaration type alone.
ambiguities: D009 omits the definition or constructors of IsProbabilityMeasure, so the packet does not permit independent verification that it means μ(Ω)=1 or any other particular normalization.
D007 and D010 omit the structure fields and axioms of MeasurableSpace and Measure; their roles are clear from their types, but their full mathematical semantics are unavailable.
D015 supplies only the type of Real; its intended real-number role is strongly indicated by the accompanying structures, but its underlying construction is not supplied.
D029 exposes the integral implementation only as an opaque projection, so its precise construction and behavior outside the integrability assumptions cannot be recovered.
D008 unfolds Integrable only one level: the exact definitions of AEStronglyMeasurable and HasFiniteIntegral are not supplied.
